classgraphmine_1_1view__detail_1_1anonym.returns: The digest as lowercase hexadecimal text.
details: Throws std::runtime_error if finalization fails. Call only after the complete record stream has been supplied.

namespacegraphmine_1_1view__detail_1aff8.summary: Fingerprint canonical native graph records without a JSON round trip.

parameters.graph: Graph whose descriptor, ordered vertices/edges, optional metadata, and typed property values are hashed.

namespacegraphmine_1_1view__detail_1aff8.returns: A lowercase SHA-256 digest using the graphmine-native-records-v2 encoding.
details: The hash preserves numeric representations, external-ID types, missing-versus-present fields, and record order. It is a snapshot fingerprint, not a graph-isomorphism invariant.

structgraphmine_1_1representation__store.summary: Remove the least-recently-used representation from the shared cache.
structgraphmine_1_1representation__store.returns: No value. Decreases retained bytes, erases the entry and recency node, and increments the eviction counter.
details: Internal precondition: the caller holds the cache mutex and the recency list is nonempty. Existing shared owners can keep the removed representation alive.

namespacegraphmine_1_1representation__st.returns: A mutable reference to the function-local singleton Cache.
details: The accessor itself does not lock. lookup(), insert(), and control() acquire the cache mutex before touching shared state.

namespacegraphmine_1_1representation__st.summary: Look up an immutable representation and update its least-recently-used position.

parameters.key: Representation key, including any required snapshot and policy/version components.

namespacegraphmine_1_1representation__st.returns: A copied Entry with shared ownership on a hit, or nullopt on a miss.
details: Holds the cache mutex while searching, incrementing hit/miss counters, and moving a hit to the front of the recency list.

namespacegraphmine_1_1representation__st.summary: Admit an immutable representation to the size-bounded cache, reusing an existing entry for the same key.

parameters.value: Shared immutable representation to retain; existing external owners remain valid.
parameters.bytes: Storage charged against the cache limit.
parameters.work: Work amount recorded with the entry.
parameters.winner: Optional output pointer receiving the retained representation, which may be an existing winner for this key.

namespacegraphmine_1_1representation__st.returns: True when an existing or new entry is retained; false when caching is disabled or this entry exceeds the limit.
details: Locks shared cache state and evicts least-recently-used entries until the new value fits.
On a duplicate key, the existing representation wins. A false return leaves winner untouched; callers should initialize it before the call.

namespacegraphmine_1_1representation__st.summary: Inspect or change cache capacity and optionally clear retained entries and counters.

parameters.limit: Optional replacement byte limit; a present zero disables retention.
parameters.clear: If true, clear all entries and reset hit/miss/eviction counters after applying the limit.

namespacegraphmine_1_1representation__st.returns: Current limit, retained bytes, entry count, hits, misses, and evictions.
details: All changes occur under the cache mutex. Reducing the limit evicts least-recently-used entries until retained bytes fit. Shared values held by callers remain alive after eviction.

namespacegraphmine_1_1view__detail_1a8a0.summary: Reuse or build an immutable standard view keyed by its input snapshot and canonical specification.

parameters.canonical: Canonical serialized ViewSpec, included in the representation key.
parameters.options: Budget-charge and observation callbacks for the view request.
parameters.build: Builder invoked only on a cache miss; returns the fully populated ViewResult.

namespacegraphmine_1_1view__detail_1a8a0.returns: Shared ownership of a const ViewResult, whether retained in the cache or returned only to this caller.
details: A hit charges the stored original-edge and build-work amounts before observation, so cache reuse does not bypass request budgets.
On a miss, cache accounting includes the ViewResult estimate and key storage. A concurrent insertion for the same key can supply the winning representation.
observe receives whether the request hit the cache and whether the result was retained. Callback and builder exceptions propagate.
